title: connect_ws: first comment contradicts second about case-sensitivity
description: ws/mod.rs connect_ws has two adjacent comments that contradict each other. First: 'Accept only lowercase ws:// and wss:// so the guard and tungstenite see the same string'. Second: 'Case-insensitive scheme check: RFC 3986 §3.1 allows uppercase scheme letters...'. The code actually does a case-insensitive check (lowercases before comparing) and passes the ORIGINAL URL to tungstenite — not lowercase. The first comment is wrong. Remove the first comment; the second accurately describes the behavior.
